answer_1.quote: Professional Communication Improvement: Involves refining or improving existing text to enhance its professional tone or clarity.
answer_1.outputs: Automatically generated fine‑grained categories with associated performance scores.

answer_2.quote: We define A_{s,hi} to be the accuracy of s on category hi … We compare these scores to s's baseline performance on all inputs, denoted as A_{s,Q}.

answer_3.quote: We use Claude 3 Opus as the category scorer.

answer_4.quote: We conducted the human evaluation using the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform and expert volunteers.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to select which of two questions best matches a given category.
